lines.zh: 我的脚步让整片洞穴震。
lines.en: My steps shake the whole cavern.
My spine brushes the cave roof.

lines.zh: 我每挪一步，洞顶就落灰。
lines.en: Each step of mine drops dust from the roof.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下深坑。
lines.en: Deep pits remain where I walk.
My tail drags along.
I knock the pillar out of the way.
My head is low; my neck is thick.
I stop and take a breath.
My feet sink into the ground.
I turn slowly, clumsily.
The scales on my back gleam.
One step is two blocks for me.
The scales on my back shift in layers.

lines.zh: 我把洞顶的一块石头蹭下来。
lines.en: I scrape a stone loose from the roof.
I walk along the rock wall.

lines.zh: 地在我脚下一点点陷下去。
lines.en: The ground gives a little under each step.
I stand, breathing deep.
My body is still warm.
I rest my head on the rock.

lines.zh: 我胸腔里像有座炉子在响。
lines.en: Something in my chest hums like a furnace.

lines.zh: 我的脚步留下的坑还没平。
lines.en: The pits from my steps haven't settled.

lines.zh: 我眼皮合上时像放下块石板。
lines.en: My eyelid closes like a slab of stone coming down.
My teeth show and disappear.
I look at the crack in the roof.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过一堆铀晶。
lines.en: My tail sweeps through a heap of uranium.
There is dust on my hide.
I wait for my body to cool.
I settle my belly onto the cool stone.
I open my mouth and breathe out heat.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖一下下点着石面。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the stone again and again.
I tuck my foreclaws under me.
I am counting my own heartbeats.
You are at my feet, tiny.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把你看进眼里。
lines.en: I lower my head and take you in.
You carry a smell of nuclear things.
I know that kind of light.
Get away from my feet.
I might step on you by accident.
I stretch my neck down.
Can you reach me?
My breath is hot.
Stand further off so I can see you.

lines.zh: 我把庞大的身子转过来。
lines.en: I swing my huge body around.
I don't want to bring the roof down.
I step back and the ground collapses.
My hide is cut open.
Those blows felt like a tickle.

lines.zh: 我看了看身上那道浅痕。
lines.en: I look at the shallow mark on my hide.
I press my chest plate to the rubble.
I steady my four legs.
This isn't enough to weaken my legs.
I haul my neck back up.
After all that, I haven't given an inch.
I sink lower and steady my weight.
What are you holding up?
Too far. I lean closer.
That smell is a little familiar.
Leave it on that flat stone.
I don't much need to eat.
Step back and I'll bend down.
This thing is too small.
This smells of burnt rock.

lines.zh: 你留着，那点东西不够我。
lines.en: Keep it; it's not enough for me.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子凑到那东西前面。
lines.en: I bring my nose right up to it.
That in your hand is too small.
I lean in to look.
Lift it to where I can smell it.
I think I've smelled this before.
I can see it on the ground; step back.
I stretch my head over.
You run into my foreleg.
I didn't even twitch a scale.
You can't move my weight.
My foot nudges you aside.
Don't press against my belly plate.
I move my foot away slowly.

lines.zh: 地面被我们压塌了一块。
lines.en: The floor caves where we collide.

lines.zh: 你的重量在我脚上像粒沙。
lines.en: Your weight on my foot is a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 我低头看有没有压到你。
lines.en: I look down to check I didn't crush you.
Clear my footing.
I am too big for that.
I fear I'd crush you.
This body of mine has no room for anyone.
Don't climb on my back.
My back is hot.
Sitting here is enough.
Stand in my shadow.
I lower my head slowly.
I listen when you speak.
I am used to being alone.
I dip my head and lip it up.
Not enough to grind my teeth.
One bite crushed it.
This tastes of stone.
I nudge it aside with a foot.
I snort at it.
This one glows a bit.

lines.zh: 我用脚尖把它碾进石缝。
lines.en: I grind it into a seam with my toe.
I don't care about things that fall.
I drag it over the rock.
You stepped in my pit.
I raise my head from the cave floor.
Something is rising in my throat.
There's light on you, and I know it.
You picked the wrong cave.
One stride puts me in front of you.

lines.zh: 你背后是石壁，前面是我。
lines.en: Rock behind you, and me in front.
At three I charge.
My shoulder is already coming.
I have planted myself in front of you.
I follow you, one footfall at a time.

lines.zh: 我的脚步让石头跳起来。
lines.en: My steps make the stones jump.
Listen — the whole cave is shaking.
I snapped a stalagmite.
Running there won't help.
I bring half my body closer.

lines.zh: 我呼出的热气在你头顶。
lines.en: My hot breath is above your head.
Dark water is at your back.
That shallow water won't stop me.
My head is at your chest.

lines.zh: 我一脚把地面踏出裂缝。
lines.en: My foot drives a crack through the floor.
I whip my head and you're knocked away.
My tail sweeps across.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整个身体的重量。
lines.en: That carried my whole weight.
I butt the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我落地的一脚掀翻了你。
lines.en: My landing foot knocks you over.
My teeth are thicker than your leg.
You blocked. It didn't help.
I step back and catch my breath.
I stop ramming.
I come out from behind the rock.
My body is still glowing.
This cave isn't tall enough.
I lower my head and take in this ground.
Rubble slides off my back.
The breath I let out comes as a heat wave.
I sweep the walls, looking for a way out.
My feet sink into the ground.
I start walking.
The floor caved beneath me.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，我甩了甩。
lines.en: Fire catches my back; I shake it off.
I fell and smashed through the floor.
The water only reaches my knees, but it's cold.

lines.zh: 火光散开，我连皮都没破。
lines.en: The flash clears and my hide isn't even scorched.
An arrowhead sticks in my shoulder.
Spell-light spreads over my back.
There's no meat in this cave.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我跳了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hit my back and I lurched.
The ground is gone; I sink.
